archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: every step: the one way a kit agent posts a line on its board
question: How do I post a board line that passes the board rules (stamp first, under 578 characters, no em dash)?
usage_from_code: python3 -B <Alarm>/Agentic/tree/ALARM_DESIGN/KIT_V5/tools/board_line_v2.py --settings <settings file> <RUN> <KIND> "<text: what, with files and sha16>"

commands.name: post
commands.does: twins the board, then appends one line <UTC stamp> <SEAT> <KIND> <text> to BOARD/<SEAT>.txt

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: RUN
args.meaning: the run tag (its seat names the board file)

args.name: KIND
args.meaning: START CLAIM COUNT PREREG JOB DECISION STUCK ASK ANSWER CHECKPOINT DONE NOTE

args.name: text
args.meaning: what, with its files and sha16; at least 10 characters; no tab, newline or em dash
args.example: GIVENB GB1: STOP (decide_v2.py): R1 missed, 1 of 4 months (receipts/20263709_GRADE_GIVENB/HANDOFF/REAL_SEALED/REAL_RULES_GB1.tsv c0627b7443ac9fd1)

commands.example: python3 -B <INSTALL>/Agentic/tree/ALARM_DESIGN/KIT_V5/tools/board_line_v2.py --settings <INSTALL>/settings/SETTINGS_LOCAL.env AD1_20261029 DECISION "GIVENB GB1: STOP (decide_v2.py): R1 missed, 1 of 4 months (receipts/20263709_GRADE_GIVENB/HANDOFF/REAL_SEALED/REAL_RULES_GB1.tsv c0627b7443ac9fd1)"
commands.writes: BOARD/<SEAT>.txt (one line appended) and its twin BOARD/<SEAT>.txt.pre_<RUN>_<stamp> first

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr: bad usage, no --settings, BOARD empty, a bad run tag, a KIND not in the list, a tab, newline or em dash, a text under 10 characters, a line of 578 characters or more

args: docs test: a line on the planted board only
a text of more than ten characters

rules: it has no dry mode: every call that passes its checks appends a line (the docs test posts only to a planted temp board)
never deletes; twins the board before the append
dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
